interactables.text:
About

The 1:4 Scale Formula 1 Framed Car Replica – Red Bull Edition from the Carbon Series brings together motorsport engineering and premium wall art design. Created for collectors, racing enthusiasts, and luxury interiors, this framed Formula 1 display piece transforms your passion for the Red Bull Racing team into a refined statement for any space.

Measuring 120 cm (Width) × 50 cm (Height) and weighing approximately 10 kg, this expertly crafted replica features a detailed 1:4 scale Red Bull Formula 1 car mounted on a premium display frame. Designed to elevate offices, showrooms, living spaces, or motorsport galleries, the frame delivers a striking visual presence while maintaining a clean and elegant aesthetic.

The display frame is available in several premium finishes, allowing collectors to select a style that complements their environment. Each piece combines precision detailing with high-quality materials to create a distinctive motorsport collectible and décor element.

Key Features

1:4 scale Red Bull Formula 1 car replica framed display

Designed as premium motorsport wall art

Dimensions: approx. 120 cm (W) × 50 cm (H)

Weight: approx. 10 kg

Available in premium finishes: Carbon Wrap, Real Carbon Fiber, Forged Carbon, and Lacquer Paint

Precision detailing inspired by Formula 1 engineering

Suitable for offices, showrooms, homes, and motorsport collections
